_comment: This hook configuration uses Claude Code's PreToolUse hook schema.
It is invoked by Claude Code (via .claude/** settings), NOT by GitHub Copilot natively.
GitHub Copilot does not have a PreToolUse hook system equivalent.
Placement in .github/hooks/ reflects Copilot-namespace ownership of the script asset,
but enforcement is Claude-side only. Copilot boundary rules are enforced through
agent instructions, skill procedures, and the agent tools list instead.
